name: ai-media-batch-kit
description: Reference code + playbook for batch image/video generation via logged-in Chrome profiles (Google Flow/Veo 3, Muse, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) over CDP, plus free/cheap TTS voices (Edge, Gemini TTS, ai33) with Vietnamese text normalization, multi-voice dubbing and subtitles. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: node test/queue.test.js && node test/page-scripts.test.js && node test/profile-lock.test.js && node test/voice.test.js

author: Hai Tran (https://github.com/tranthanhhai1997)
